summary: Iris Acquisition Corp II (SPAC) filed an 8-K reporting the termination of its non-binding letter of intent for a business combination with Freedom Metals Corporation, originally announced on March 9, 2026. No deal terms, price per share, premium, or advisors were disclosed. The termination is effective May 13, 2026, per the registrant's notification to the target. As a blank-check company, this leaves the SPAC without a pending transaction, triggering a search for an alternative target or potential liquidation if it fails to complete a deal within its charter deadline. The risk-arb angle is nil; the focus shifts to the SPAC's remaining timeline and whether it can secure a new merger partner before dissolution.
